mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT ni.news_info_id AS newsInfoId, ni.news_title AS title, ni.news_description AS description FROM news_info ni
LEFT JOIN news_analysis na ON ni.news_info_id = na.news_info_id
WHERE na.news_info_id IS NULL ORDER BY ni.published_at DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_analysis ( news_info_id, sentiment, score, ai_summary, analyzed_at ) VALUES ( #{newsInfoId}, #{sentiment}, #{score}, #{aiSummary}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ns.stock_code AS stockCode, s.stock_name AS stockName, ni.news_info_id AS newsInfoId, ni.news_title AS title, ni.news_description AS description, na.sentiment AS sentiment, na.score AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ns.stock_code ORDER BY ni.published_at DESC ) rn FROM news_info_stock ns
JOIN news_info ni ON ns.news_info_id = ni.news_info_id JOIN news_analysis na ON ni.news_info_id = na.news_info_id JOIN stocks s ON ns.stock_code = s.stock_code ) WHERE rn <= 3
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO stock_ai_summary sas USING dual ON (sas.stock_code = #{stockCode})
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET sentiment = #{sentiment}, summary = #{summary}, score = #{score}, updated_at = SYSDATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( stock_code, sentiment, summary, score, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{sentiment}, #{summary}, #{score}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.stock_code AS stockCode, s.stock_name AS stockName, s.sector AS sector, s.market_type AS marketType, ci.issued_stock AS issuedStock, ci.declined_stock AS declinedStock, ci.treasury_stock AS treasuryStock, ci.outstanding_shares AS outstandingShares, ci.minority_shareholder_ratio AS minorityShareholderRatio, ci.minority_ownership_ratio AS minorityOwnershipRatio FROM stocks s
LEFT JOIN co_information ci ON s.stock_code = ci.stock_code LEFT JOIN stock_ai_report sar ON s.stock_code = sar.stock_code
WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( sar.updated_at IS NULL OR sar.updated_at < SYSDATE - 1 )) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20

SELECT title FROM ( SELECT n.news_title AS title FROM news_info n
LEFT JOIN news_info_stock ns ON n.news_info_id = ns.news_info_id
WHERE ns.stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY n.published_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO stock_ai_report target
USING ( SELECT #{stockCode} AS stock_code, #{investmentOpinion} AS investment_opinion, #{confidenceScore} AS confidence_score, #{summary} AS summary, #{riskFactors} AS risk_factors, #{positiveFactors} AS positive_factors, #{aiSignal} AS ai_signal FROM dual ) source
ON ( target.stock_code = source.stock_code )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET investment_opinion = source.investment_opinion, confidence_score = source.confidence_score, summary = source.summary, risk_factors = source.risk_factors, positive_factors = source.positive_factors, ai_signal = source.ai_signal, updated_at = SYSDATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( stock_code, investment_opinion, confidence_score, summary, risk_factors, positive_factors, ai_signal, updated_at ) VALUES ( source.stock_code, source.investment_opinion, source.confidence_score, source.summary, source.risk_factors, source.positive_factors, source.ai_signal, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT stock_code, investment_opinion, confidence_score, summary, risk_factors, positive_factors, ai_signal, updated_at FROM stock_ai_report WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}
SELECT user_no, survey_type, actual_investment_type, portfolio_risk_analysis, ai_recommendations, created_at, updated_at FROM user_ai_profile WHERE user_no = #{userNo}

mapper.update: UPDATE user_ai_profile SET survey_type = #{surveyType}, actual_investment_type = #{actualInvestmentType}, portfolio_risk_analysis = #{portfolioRiskAnalysisJson}, ai_recommendations = #{aiRecommendationsJson}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
